propositions: Plan-review Pass-4 coaching renders findings per instance rather than per root cause, causing authors to receive multiple instance-level fixes for the same underlying enumeration-method failure without signal that the method itself is faulty.
Existing move 12 ('Generalize across the rest of the work') lacks machine-checkable completeness proof, allowing authors to claim enumeration is complete across multiple passes when it is not.
A new scoped coaching move must reframe named instances as samples from a population and require machine-checkable acceptance criteria (e.g. grep for zero matches) to verify completeness.
Move 15 must apply only to criteria where a population actually exists: G1G2, E4, G6, and A1 — criteria in codebase-grounding and approach-soundness facets that name members of enumerable sets.
